visual.general_description: Grayscale axial lung-window CT slice through the upper thorax.
visual.detailed_description: Axial slice at the level of the shoulders and upper chest, lung window. The round dark trachea lies at the midline in front of a vertebral body. On the left side of the image there is a small dark aerated region with a lobulated outpouching toward the midline and fine dot-like vessels; on the right side of the image there is a larger, uniformly dark region without visible vessel markings next to the ribs. The upper arm bones are seen laterally at the image edges, the scanner table curve is at the bottom, and thin curvilinear lines run over the air above the anterior chest. No arrows, letters, side markers or other text are visible.
